title: Passkey registration request
description: What basalt init puts in the registration link: <base>/passkeys/register#1.<base64url(this JSON)>. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals and Page links.

userName.description: Label in the passkey picker, e.g. the database name.

handBack.description: 16 random bytes, base64url: the secret of the hand-back route of the pages basalt init serves itself. Only init's own server's links carry it; the page then posts the passkey to POST /api/v1/passkeys/register with it in the basalt-link-secret header instead of showing a code to paste. See CONTRACT.md, CLI.
